title: Colorado River RZR Tour + Ghost Town + Lunch + Adventure Zone
includes: RZR off-road vehicle (2-seater or 4-seater, based on option selected)
Includes Safety Gear-Youth-Adult 6X helmets, goggles, gloves, shiesty, & Safety Instructions
Guided 1861 Ghost Town sightseeing walking tour
Adventure Zone-Hatchet Throwing, Large outdoor games, Gel Gun wars, corn hole, horseshoes, and more
Professional guided off-road RZR tour to the Scenic Colorado River
Damage fees for RZR (see waiver for details) (not included)
Hotel pickup for Drive-To-Location option (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All participants are required to sign a waiver.
Minimum age to drive is 18 years with a valid drivers license and credit card on file with Awesome Adventures
Riders under 18 years must have a parent or guardian present
Minimum Age for passengers is 5 years old or 42 lbs, Max weight 350lbs
policies: No Crocs, Yeezy’s, high heels, slip-on shoes, flip flops, sandals, or open-toed shoes! You MUST have completely closed-toe shoes to ride or drive for your safety! If you show up without wearing closed-toe shoes, you will not be able to ride. Sneakers, boots, or closed-toed shoes only

Credit Card must be called into the suppler before tour begins for any incidentals that happen on tour. Credit Card holder is responsible for all incidents/damages and credit card will be charged to cover the damages.

Minimum numbers apply. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there is not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund
2 Seater RZR damages USD $600.00 for a tire/rim damages; a minimum USD $3500.00 if rolled or tipped on side.
Safety gear provided & a Safety and Operations Orientation provided before tour begins.

We recommend no shorts due to the desert terrain and cacti. You are in the desert and need to be aware that rattlesnakes, cacti, and other wildlife may be present. We do our best to keep you safe, but you are still in the desert, so please dress accordingly.
4 Seater RZR damages USD $600.00 for a tire/rim damages; a minimum USD $4500.00 if rolled or tipped on side.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience one of the most exciting Las Vegas off-road Adrenaline Adventure with a guided RZR tour to the Colorado River. Begin with 1861 Ghost Town walking tour filled with vintage vehicles, rare antiques, Old West buildings & Mad Max flare with relics from the gold rush era. Hear amazing stories about famous movies, reality TV shows, music videos, and celebrities, who have filmed here over the years. It's one of Nevada's most favorite destinations. 

Next, ride through rugged desert trails through the Eldorado Canyons with panoramic views, in your choice of a 2 or 4-seater RZR. 
Arrive at the Colorado River to relax, cool off, and enjoy a delicious lunch with stunning waterfront views. 

After your ride, head to the Adventure Zone—more laughter & bit of competitiveness w/lots of FUN outdoor games. We are more than just an ATV ride we are a destination you don’t want to miss. You'll leave with unforgettable memories and share-worthy content from this action-packed Las Vegas adventure.
